## 2. Code Style

### 2.1 Naming Conventions

| Element | Convention | Example |
|---------|-----------|---------|
| Variables / functions | camelCase | `cartItems`, `handleSubmit()` |
| React components | PascalCase | `SlideCart`, `HeroSection` |
| Component directories | PascalCase | `SlideCart/`, `HeroSection/` |
| Component entry point | `index.tsx` | `SlideCart/index.tsx` |
| Hooks | `use` prefix, camelCase | `useScrollAnimation`, `useCart` |
| TypeScript interfaces (component props) | `I` prefix + PascalCase | `IProduct`, `ISlideCart`, `ICategory` |
| Constants / enum values | SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE | `ACTION_TYPES.ADD_PRODUCT`, `CART_STORAGE_KEY` |
| App Router route directories | kebab-case (Vietnamese) | `gio-hang/`, `thanh-toan/`, `chinh-sach-doi-tra/` |
| Utility files | camelCase | `priceFormatter.ts`, `useScrollAnimation.ts` |
| Environment variables | UPPER_SNAKE_CASE | `DATABASE_URL`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL` |


### 2.2 Patterns to Follow

- Composition over inheritance — compose section and component layers
- `'use client'` directive only where browser APIs or interactivity are required — keep server components as the default
- Props typed via inline interface declared above the component (`interface IMyComponent { ... }`)
- Context consumed via custom hook wrapper (`useCart()`) — never import context object directly in consumers
- Default export for every component; named exports for hooks, context providers, and utilities
- Sub-components tightly coupled to one parent may be defined in the same `index.tsx` file
- All navigation uses `next/link`; all images use `next/image`
- Icons from `lucide-react` only — do not add a new icon library
- Tailwind design tokens over arbitrary values (`text-main` over `text-[#232323]`)
- Fail fast in reducers: `default` case must throw (`throw new Error('Unhandled action: ' + type)`)


### 2.3 Patterns to Avoid

- `console.log` or debug statements committed to production code
- `any` type in TypeScript without a comment justifying it
- Direct `CartContext` import in consumer components — use `useCart()` instead
- Adding product/category data directly to `constants.ts` for items that should come through `npm run sync`
- Hard-coding colors, spacing, or breakpoints outside Tailwind tokens — use `tailwind.config.ts` tokens
- Empty catch blocks — always handle or re-throw errors
- `reactStrictMode: false` changes — do not disable strict mode without reason
- Deep nesting (> 3 levels) — use early returns or extracted components


### 2.4 Project-Specific Patterns

```
- All product/category data changes go through the data pipeline: scrape → Excel → npm run sync → rebuild
- News articles and app metadata (phone, address, social links) are edited directly in src/config/constants.ts
- Cart interactions must use cartReducer dispatch actions (ACTION_TYPES enum) — never mutate cart state directly
- localStorage reads must be wrapped in try/catch with a safe fallback value
- Scroll animations use the AnimateOnScroll wrapper component or the useScrollAnimation hook — not ad-hoc CSS transitions
- Checkout form fields must have both client-side validation and (when a backend exists) server-side validation
```

## 3. Project Policies

All `required: no` by default. Set `required: yes` to make violations blockers in code review.

---

### 3.1 Feature Flags

```yaml
feature_flags:
  provider: none
  required: no
  pattern: ~
```

---

### 3.2 Observability

```yaml
observability:
  provider: none
  required: no
  requirement: ~
```

> When `required: yes`: new endpoints/workers without metrics+tracing = blocker.

---

### 3.3 Internationalization (i18n)

```yaml
i18n:
  required: no
  requirement: ~
```

> Note: The UI is currently hard-coded Vietnamese. If multi-language support is added, use next-intl or i18next.

---

### 3.4 Accessibility (a11y)

```yaml
a11y:
  required: no
  requirement: ~
```

> Recommended: all product images must have meaningful `alt` text in Vietnamese. `next/image` requires the `alt` prop.
